title: CCBRT
description: ccbrt.org CCBRT (Comprehensive Community Based Rehabilitation in Tanzania) is the largest disability hospital in Tanzania, founded in 1994 in Dar es Salaam by the German organization CBM, with over 600 staff and more than 2 million patients served over 30 years. It provides ophthalmology including over 10,000 cataract surgeries, orthopedic rehabilitation, plastic surgery for burns and cleft lip, obstetric fistula repair and community-based disability programs across all 26 Tanzanian regions. Over 20,000 surgical procedures have been performed for people with disabilities including 3,000 fistula repairs and 5,000 clubfoot corrections using the Ponseti method. The organization combines a multi-specialty hospital in Dar es Salaam with mobile outreach teams reaching remote communities. Funding comes from CBM, international donors including USAID and the World Bank, the Tanzanian government and a social enterprise model.
